file spfi_encrypt spfi_encrypt.vhd

# Notes
# - open-logic-ft: Clone with the submodule 3rdParty/en_cl_fix (git clone --recursive); compile_order.txt lists its
#   files. 4.7.0-ft.6 adds olo_base_chunker and olo_axi_lite_decoder to 4.7.0-ft.2 (ft.3), fixes the error reporting of
#   olo_axi_master_simple and the write word count of olo_axi_master_full (ft.4), the address of transfers that
#   olo_axi_master_simple splits at AxiMaxBeats_g (ft.5), and the transfers of olo_axi_master_full with 8-bit data and
#   narrow addresses (ft.6). 4.7.0-ft.8 adds the response code of a failed command to the AXI masters (outputs
#   Wr_ErrorResp and Rd_ErrorResp), olo_intf_can and the Reed-Solomon codec (olo_base_rs_encode, olo_base_rs_decode),
#   and fixes the beat counters of olo_axi_master_simple and the write word count of the largest commands of
#   olo_axi_master_full (ft.7); it adds FIXED bursts to the AXI masters (inputs CmdWr_Fixed and CmdRd_Fixed, default
#   '0'), olo_base_stream_join and olo_base_stream_split, drives Out_Be of olo_base_wconv_n2m with equal widths, and
#   checks the byte enables of olo_base_wconv_n2m and the commands of olo_intf_i2c_master at the clock edge (ft.8).
#   4.7.0-ft.11 lets olo_axi_master_full overlap consecutive commands and adds the generics IntFifoDepth_g and
#   EccPipeline_g to the fault-tolerant AXI masters (ft.9), resets the read alignment register of olo_axi_master_full
#   (ft.10), matches the scoped constraint of the read path of olo_base_ram_sdp also after synthesis retiming and checks
#   In_Last and In_Be of olo_base_crc only for an accepted beat (ft.11). The cores of the catalog are verified with
#   4.7.0-ft.6 (OpenWire, OpenSPP, OpenCrypto, OpenCompact); 4.7.0-ft.11 (OpenRMAP, OpenFibre); the ports added since
#   4.7.0-ft.6 have a default (inputs) or may stay open (outputs), so every core compiles with 4.7.0-ft.11 unchanged.
# - openrmap: The submodules of the repository (open-logic, uvvm) serve its own tests; a system uses the olo library of
#   the Composer.
# - openspp: The submodules of the repository (open-logic, uvvm) serve its own tests; a system uses the olo library of
#   the Composer.
# - openfibre: The submodules of the repository (open-logic, uvvm) serve its own tests; a system uses the olo library of
#   the Composer. compile_order.txt lists the technology-independent sources; the vendor-specific physical adapter
#   ofb_pa_gty is added separately (see its notes).
# - opencrypto: The submodules of the repository (open-logic, uvvm) serve its own tests; a system uses the olo library
#   of the Composer.
# - ofb_pa_gty: Vendor-specific (AMD Versal GTY). Its entity (hdl/ofb_pa_gty/src/ofb_pa_gty.vhd), its lane reset
#   sequencer (hdl/ofb_pa_gty/src/ofb_pa_gty_lane_rst.vhd) and its architecture struct
#   (hdl/ofb_pa_gty/src/ofb_pa_gty_struct.vhd) are not in compile_order.txt of the repository but in
#   hdl/ofb_pa_gty/compile_order.txt: add them to the library openfibre after the core, and create the transceiver
#   wizard instance ofb_gtw in the Vivado project with hdl/ofb_pa_gty/tcl/ofb_gtw.tcl (source the file, then
#   ofb_gtw_create ofb_gtw 156.25 for a 156.25 MHz reference clock or ofb_gtw_create ofb_gtw 100 for 100 MHz).
# - ofb_pa_gty: RefClk is the output O of the IBUFDS_GTE5 of the reference clock pins of the quad; place the buffer in
#   the chip-level top, as hdl/ofb_vck190/src/ofb_vck190_top.vhd does.
# - ofb_pa_gty: Stat_TxReady reaches Phy_TxReady of the core through the Phy interface; the core holds the link in
#   Near-End Reset while the transmitters are not ready, so its reset needs no status of the adapter. The VCK190
#   reference design resets the core and the adapter with the power-on reset.
# - ofb_pa_gty: The line rate is 6.25 Gbit/s, so LaneClk runs at 156.25 MHz; the reference clock is 100 MHz or 156.25
#   MHz, the frequency the wizard instance is created for (PA-CK-01).
# - ofb_pa_gty: Phy_NoSignal is always 0 (PA-IF-03): the receiver of the transceiver gives no loss of signal indication
#   at 6.25 Gbit/s, so a lost signal reaches the Lane layer as words with errors (RXERR), and an end with AutoStart
#   leaves Wait at once and starts like an end with LaneStart.
# - ofb_pa_gty: Phy_CdrEnable does not stop the clock data recovery: its falling edge, when the lane leaves the states
#   that use the line, starts the entire receiver reset of the lane (PA-IF-02, PA-RS-04; PA_CTRL RX_RESET_ON_DISCONNECT
#   of the core), and LANE_CTRL RX_RESET of the core requests one. The adapter drops further requests of the lane for
#   RxRstGapCycles_g after a reset, so that a lane with the initialisation timeout of the standard makes initialisation
#   attempts between two resets; a design with a longer timeout (InitTimeoutWords_g of the core, LANE_INIT_TIMEOUT) sets
#   RxRstGapCycles_g = 0, as the VCK190 reference design does. The CDR is held while the receiver reports electrical
#   idle (PA-IF-04, PA_CTRL CDR_HOLD_IDLE).
# - ofb_pa_gty: The architecture struct needs the AMD transceiver models in a simulation (unisim and the simulation
#   files of the wizard; OpenFibre runs them with tools/run_xsim.py). GHDL and QuestaSim simulate the adapter with its
#   behavioural model, the architecture mdl in plain VHDL: hdl/ofb_pa_gty/compile_order_sim.txt lists it instead of
#   struct, with the 8B/10B package, ofb_pa_model_pkg (ModelIdx_g selects the control record of an instance) and the
#   lane reset sequencer, which the model uses as well. QuestaSim needs a time resolution of 1 fs (vsim -t fs) when the
#   reference clocks of the ends differ by fractions of a picosecond, for example a few hundred ppm.
# - open-logic-ft: AMD Vivado: source the script of Open Logic once. It reads the scoped constraints of
#   olo_base_cc_reset, olo_base_cc_bits, olo_base_cc_simple, olo_base_reset_gen and olo_base_ram_sdp wherever the system
#   uses them, also inside the cores. tools/vivado/all_constraints_amd.tcl would also read those of olo_intf_sync, which
#   expect device pins at its input and stop the build (ERROR 18-513) where a block synchronises internal signals with
#   it, as ofb_pa_gty does; a block that synchronises device pins declares its own false path for them. File
#   src/base/tcl/olo_base_constraints_amd.tcl.
